name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: Your posting names the failure I spent years on the receiving end of: a high-intent request that sits too long before it reaches the rep. I was that rep for years, as a BDR at Senior Directory and an AE at Fivestars and Accelo, working out of HubSpot and Salesforce. Now I build the systems that prevent it. At Solenzo I run the full operational surface for clients: CRM and marketing automation administration, field mapping and lifecycle stages, and the webhooks, REST calls, and LLM API calls that connect it all, in Zapier, Make, n8n, and GoHighLevel.

The agentic AI work in this role is the work I already ship. I built a scoring workflow that reads unstructured signals from a prospect's web presence, scores it, and routes each lead into personalized outreach, running in production with 180+ businesses enrolled. I document what I build and teach people to run it, a habit from leading onboarding teams of up to 30 at Wix. To be direct about the gap: I've worked with intent and routing data synced into Salesforce, but haven't administered a platform like 6sense or Demandbase, and my recent systems work has been at small-business scale. That's the part I'd close first.
I'd welcome a conversation about where Talkdesk's routing and ABM orchestration should be in 90 days. I'm at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
